forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.

my_fields.title: My fields
my_fields.help: Numbers you track for yourself. Colleagues can see them next to your name, and only you can change them.

help.institution: Who you are and how the tool counts years. The defaults work, so change only what differs.
help.users: Invite people and choose what they can do. People are switched off rather than deleted, so their name stays in the history.
help.lists: The values people choose from. To retire an entry, switch off Active: releases that use it keep it.
help.researchers: Everyone named on a release. Tidy up names, add identifiers and merge duplicates. Nothing here changes any statistics, because releases refer to the record and not the name.
help.form: Adapt the fields on a release: rename, hide, require or reorder them, or add your own.
help.checkpoints: The moments after a release when numbers are collected, and which numbers those are.
help.data: Your backups, a full copy of your data, and what the automatic jobs have been doing.

institution.timezone_hint: Dates show in this time zone. Nightly jobs switch over at the next restart.
institution.website_domain_hint: Website views count only for releases on exactly this address, for example news.example.org.
institution.contact_email_hint: Sent to Crossref when looking up papers. Use a shared office address, not a person's.
institution.code_pattern_hint: Release Radar assigns the codes itself. {yyyy} is the academic year and {nn} the number. A change affects new codes only: existing codes never change.
institution.landing_hint: The first page after signing in. Someone with no writer entry always lands on all releases.

users.name: Name
users.no_email: The email couldn't be sent. Please pass this temporary password on to {{email}} yourself:
users.new_password_question: Sign them out and send a new one?
users.reset_sent: A new temporary password was emailed to {{email}}.
users.personal_help: Fields people track for themselves. When someone leaves, pass theirs on or make them institution fields. The values stay either way.
users.personal_convert_question: Everyone will use this field from now on. Continue?

lists.writers_help: Writers need no account, so former staff can stay on their releases.
lists.vocabularies_help: Named lists of choices for custom fields, in both languages.

form.core_help: Leave a label empty to keep the standard one. Hidden fields keep their data.
form.cannot_hide: Release Radar relies on this field, so it stays visible.
form.custom_help: Extra fields for everyone in your institution. Personal ones are under My fields in the account menu.

checkpoints.measures_help: The numbers collected at each checkpoint. Switching one off keeps what was recorded.
checkpoints.locked: Goes live with pickups, in a later phase.
checkpoints.reminders_later: Reminder settings arrive with the reminders themselves, in a later phase.

data.backup_not_configured: Backups are off, because no passphrase is set on the server. Please ask whoever runs the server.
data.export_help: A complete copy of your data for safekeeping. Passwords and sessions are left out.
data.import_later: Importing the existing workbook arrives in a later step.

researchers.name: Name as entered
researchers.merge_hint: Search for the record to keep. Its details stay, and gaps are filled from this one.
researchers.merge_question: Move {{count}} release(s) to {{name}} and retire this record?

custom_field.options_hint: One per line, with the Japanese after a bar: Newspaper | 新聞
custom_field.due_hint: Shows up as a reminder at this checkpoint.
